messages:
sana-peopleops: @leo-candidate quick thread to lock down logistics for your onsite day in Lisbon next month. We saw your travel note — prefer afternoon interviews due to time zone jetlag. Can you confirm preferred arrival date and any mobility or dietary needs?

leo-candidate: Hi Sana 9: thanks. Prefer interviews in the afternoon (local time) and would like arrival the day before. No dietary restrictions but need wheelchair access to the meeting room and a quiet room for breaks. Also request hotel near office; public transit is fine.

anya-recruiter: Noted. Hiring team prefers the 2pm start so we'll aim for a schedule that starts 14:00 and ends by 17:30. Devon, does that work for the panel?

devon-hiringmgr: 14:00 start is fine. We'll do 45m coding + 45m system design + 30m hiring manager + 15m buffer. Please arrange a private quiet room for Leo between interviews.

office-ops: We can book a nearby accessible hotel (two-night stay) and reserve Meeting Room B (wheelchair accessible) and Quiet Room 2. Will attach accessible route map and elevator codes. Also will prepare a transit reimbursement form.

sana-peopleops: Leo, would you like airport pickup or public transit reimbursement? We can cover a taxi if luggage + mobility is a concern.

leo-candidate: Taxi pickup would be helpful given luggage and mobility. Thank you. Also can you add a short note about extra 10 minutes between rounds for rest? That helps me plan.

anya-recruiter: We'll build 10-minute buffer between rounds into the agenda. Also offering a 20-min soft intro call the morning before arrival to run through logistics?

leo-candidate: A short intro call the morning before arrival would be great.

calendar-bot: Created tentative itinerary: "Onsite Interview  Leo" 2026-11-05 14:00 WEST  Panel: devon-hiringmgr, eng1, eng2, anya-recruiter, sana-peopleops. Hotel booked tentatively: Rua Centro Hotel (accessible). Pickup scheduled: 2026-11-04 10:30 LPT. (Status: tentative)

sana-peopleops: I'll attach the accessibility checklist and consent for any onsite photo badge to the invite. Office-ops, please confirm taxi vendor and reimbursement process.

office-ops: Taxi vendor confirmed. We'll email pickup confirmation and reimbursement instructions. Quiet room reserved and meeting room set with adjustable desk.

devon-hiringmgr: Panel prebrief 13:30 same day in Meeting Room B. Prebrief agenda: roles, rubric, interview pacing, and accommodations. Please include contact number for onsite host.

anya-recruiter: Will send confirmation email to Leo after I get final pickup time from vendor and once Sana flips invite to confirmed. Leo, anything else we should note?

leo-candidate: That's everything, thanks team. Appreciate the accommodations and taxi pickup.

sana-peopleops: Great. I'll post final confirmed invite in this thread once all bookings are finalized. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
